annotations.title: Where you rank by Desk level

description: Ranks a group of players by Desk level and gives the member's place in it. Call it for 'where do I stand', 'how do I compare to the top players', a ranking or a percentile, or the top players in an age group or level. Define the group with `ageBand`, `division` and `level`, or leave them out so it fills the group from the member's team. Needs a signed-in member, because it answers about them. A key with no member gets the error member_required.

asked.description: The person's question word for word, never paraphrased. Leave it out rather than invent one.

division.description: 'men', 'women', or 'mixed' — the gender ladder. Omit to use the member's own.

includeAllSeasons.description: Set true ONLY to pool cohort membership across all years.

level.description: NTRP level as a string, e.g. '4.0' or '8.0' (mixed). Omit for a whole age-group ladder.

season.description: Optional league year for cohort membership, e.g. 2026. Defaults to the current season.

topN.description: How many top players to show (default 10).

name: query_cohort_standing
